officialRef.pdf: 02 KET真题 - 第3套 - 参考答案.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 女孩说哥哥骑摩托车把她送到学校（gave me a lift on his motorbike）。B 错：她让妈妈开车送，但车发动不起来；C 错：她平时坐公交车，但今天起晚了。

q2.explanationZh: 男孩提议下课后马上见面——1 点 10 分（at ten past one），女孩说很合适。B 错：“将近两个小时”是打球的时间；C 错：3 点 05 分是男孩要赶公交车的时间。

q3.explanationZh: 男孩说叔叔做了很好吃的比萨饼（made some lovely pizza）。A 错：叔叔很会做面包，但昨晚没有吃；B 错：表哥做的甜点对他来说太甜了。

q4.explanationZh: 女孩说她的肥皂不够了（I haven’t got enough soap），所以要买肥皂。A 错：牙刷已经装好了；B 错：她去药店买的就是梳子，已经有了。

q5.explanationZh: 女孩说她和朋友走到公交车站，然后一起上了公交车，所以她现在在公交车上。B 错：坐在轿车里的是来接她的爸爸；C 错：她只是先走到车站，现在已经在车上了。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说请 7:45 到这里（Please be here at 7:45），好把包放上大巴。8:15 是大巴从学校出发的时间，不是学生到校的时间。

q7.explanationZh: 老师说那里没地方买吃的，所以要带三明治（have sandwiches with you）。water 不对：大巴上有水，不用带。

q8.explanationZh: 老师说到了国家公园会给每人一张地图（I’ll give you all a map）。游戏和手机不对：老师让大家不要带手机。

q9.explanationZh: 老师说穿 T 恤走路比较好（A T-shirt is a good idea for our walk）。coat 不对：天气暖和，不需要穿外套。

q10.explanationZh: 老师说一整天的花费是 6 英镑 30（six pounds thirty），包括门票和大巴费。3.50 英镑只是公园门票，不是总费用。

q11.explanationZh: Kirsty 说要在购物中心外面上车（outside the shopping centre），也就是在商店附近。A 错：Zac 问是不是在学校门口，Kirsty 说不是；C 错：加油站只是在购物中心对面。

q12.explanationZh: Zac 说他的运动鞋是黑色的，Kirsty 说哥哥和他尺码一样，可以借哥哥的（鞋）。B、C 错：Kirsty 只是提醒 T 恤和短裤都要是白色的，Zac 没有要借。

q13.explanationZh: Zac 说新老师的指令总是很清楚（his instructions are always clear），Kirsty 同意（that’s right），所以他们都觉得老师的话容易懂。A 错：Zac 没说他更好；C 错：Zac 说他没有别的老师那么风趣。

q14.explanationZh: Zac 说车上会很热，所以带些水（take some water）。A 错：带音乐是 Zac 自己的做法；C 错：他说吃多了在车上看书会难受，并没有让她带吃的。

q15.explanationZh: Zac 说他原以为自己不够好、进不了球队（I didn’t think I was good enough to play!），所以很意外自己能入选。A 错：他觉得他们很可能会赢；B 错：他说的是球队很强，不是大家很友好。

q16.explanationZh: 老师说今天要大家两人一组做一张关于博物馆的海报（work in pairs and make a poster），是让学生做课堂活动。A 错：老师说不必在家完成；B 错：博物馆参观上周已经去过了。

q17.explanationZh: 男孩说这本书能让你学到很多音乐知识（teaches you a lot about music），所以它很有用。A 错：好笑的是以前借给女孩的小丑书，男孩没说这本书有趣；B 错：他说这本书页数不多。

q18.explanationZh: 男孩说他最讨厌的是因为脚受伤不得不提早回家（having to go home early），也就是假期太短了。A 错：虽然一直下雨，但他没说这是最糟的；C 错：营地有时吵，但他说没关系。

q19.explanationZh: 男孩说很高兴上周每晚都早早睡觉（went to bed early every night），也就是睡得很多。A 错：他说不担心吃什么；C 错：他甚至没有比平时练得更多。

q20.explanationZh: 男孩发短信告诉她比赛的事，但她手机没电了，看到短信时已经来不及去了，所以她事先不知道这场比赛。A 错：她根本没去；B 错：男孩问她是不是病了，她说是手机没电。

q21.explanationZh: 女孩说在那家餐厅吃饭花费太高（eating there costs so much），所以觉得贵。B 错：她说那里人不多，并不拥挤。

q22.explanationZh: 女孩说她在博物馆拍的照片很适合做历史作业（perfect for my history project），所以觉得有用。A 错：她说听起来无聊，其实并不无聊。

q23.explanationZh: 女孩说工人在修电梯，机器声音很大（so loud），所以游泳池很吵。E 错：她说还是很开心（fun），但 fun 是“好玩”，funny 是“好笑”，意思不同。

q24.explanationZh: 女孩一直想看兔子，这次看到了，她说太棒了（It was amazing!），所以觉得森林令人兴奋。F 错：妈妈让她别出声，森林是安静的，不吵。

q25.explanationZh: 女孩说在市场看到一个小丑，他把大家逗笑了（he really made us laugh），所以觉得好笑。G 错：她说小丑有时吓人，但这个不吓人；B 错：市场平时很挤，但那天不挤。

content.v: Test Three. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. How did the girl get to school this morning?
You were a bit late for class! Was the bus late?
I know that’s the usual problem, but I woke up late.
Oh no!
But my brother gave me a lift on his motorbike. I asked Mum to drive me, but our car didn’t start so I went with my brother. It was quite scary but fun!
Lucky you!
Two. What time will the friends meet tomorrow?
It’s great that we can play tennis together tomorrow.
You said you’re free to meet after the last class?
Yeah, how about just after – at ten past one? I have to get the bus at five past three but that gives us nearly two hours.
Perfect for me.
Great – see you tomorrow!
Three. What did the boy enjoy most at the meal last night?
How was your meal at your cousins’ place last night?
Well, my uncle’s a great cook.
I remember, you told me that he makes amazing bread, doesn’t he?
Unfortunately, we didn’t have any last night, but he made some lovely pizza. One of my cousins made dessert but it was a bit too sweet for me.
Four. What does the girl need to buy?
Are you ready for the camping trip tomorrow? You forgot your toothbrush last time.
I’ve already packed it, Dad. But I haven’t got enough soap – I’ve just checked.
Didn’t you get some when you went to the chemist’s?
I went to buy a comb and forgot – don’t worry, I’ll go again.
OK, that’s alright then.
Five. Where’s the girl now?
Millie, where are you? I’ve come to pick you up from school and you’re not here.
Dad! Are you in the car? I tried to phone you. School finished early. I walked to the bus stop with my friends and then got on the bus with them. It’s OK. I know where to get off.
Well next time, leave me a message!
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher talking to students about a walking trip in a National Park.
We’re going on our walking trip this week. The weather will probably be too wet on Tuesday, so we’re going on Thursday instead.
The bus will leave school at 8:15. Please be here at 7:45 so we can put all your bags on the bus.
There is water on the bus, so you don’t need to bring any. There’s nowhere to buy anything to eat, so have sandwiches with you.
The journey to the mountains isn’t very long. I know there’s a game you all play on your phones, but please don’t bring them because it’ll be very noisy.
When we get to the National Park, I’ll give you all a map.
It’s going to be warm, so you won’t need to wear a coat. A T-shirt is a good idea for our walk.
It will cost three pounds fifty each to get into the Park. We need to pay for the bus, too, so for the whole day it’s six pounds thirty. Please bring this to school tomorrow.
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear Zac talking to his friend Kirsty about a trip to play in a badminton match.
Are you ready for the badminton match tomorrow, Kirsty? Does the bus leave from the school entrance?
Actually, Zac, we’ve got to get it outside the shopping centre opposite the petrol station.
OK.
Remember we have to be all in white, including our T-shirts and shorts.
What about trainers? Mine are black!
My brother’s the same size as you – you can borrow his.
Thanks!
Is the new sports teacher coming?
Yeah. I don’t know him well but it’ll be nice to talk to him more on the trip. He’s not as funny as other teachers, but his instructions are always clear.
Yeah, that’s right. You know, it’s my first time travelling for a match.
Well, the bus gets very warm so take some water. And I take music not a book – I feel sick reading on the bus, especially if I’ve eaten a lot.
Right. Do you think we’ll win?
I’m glad we’ve got a great team for this match. In fact – I didn’t think I was good enough to play! The other team aren’t playing well and I think we’ll probably win.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear a teacher talking to her students. What’s she doing?

So, I can see everyone’s got the information you collected during our museum visit last week. And well done if you’ve brought photos. Today I’d like you to work in pairs and make a poster about the museum. We don’t have lots of time so please start immediately – it shouldn’t be necessary for you to finish this at home.
Seventeen. You will hear two friends talking about reading. What does the boy say about the book he’s just read?
What books have you read recently?
I’ve just read one about a boy who starts a school band. It’s not got too many pages.
Would I like it? I didn’t like the book you lent me about a clown.
Haha, I know you like stories based on facts, and this one teaches you a lot about music. Would you like to borrow it?
Yes, please.
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking about holidays. What was the worst problem with the boy’s holiday?
Have you been on holiday this summer?
Not yet, we’re going camping next week. Do you like camping?
Yes, but last time we went it rained constantly.
Oh no, you were unlucky! Was the campsite noisy?
Sometimes, but that didn’t matter. What I hated most was having to go home early because I’d hurt my foot!
Nineteen. You will hear a boy talking after a tennis match. How did he prepare for the match?
Well done! You played really well.
Thanks, I was lucky to win – that was one of the hardest tennis matches I’ve ever played. I’m glad I went to bed early every night last week – I needed lots of energy!
Yeah, what you eat is important too.
I didn’t worry about that, and I didn’t even practise more than usual!
Twenty. You will hear Louisa talking to her friend about a football game. Why did Louisa miss the game?
Hi Louisa. Why didn’t you come to the football game? I texted you about it. Were you ill or something?
Oh sorry, my phone battery ran out. So when I saw your message, it was already too late to go.
Oh right.
So, tell me earlier next time. And if I feel like it, I’ll come!
Cool!
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a girl talking to her grandpa about some places she went to with her parents. What was her opinion about her visit to each place?
We went to the cinema on Saturday, Grandpa.
Did you enjoy that?
Well, it was a horror film. Dad and I were frightened but Mum wasn’t.
Then did you go to a restaurant?
Yes. The food was great but there weren’t many people there. I think that’s because eating there costs so much.
Right.
On Sunday we went to an exhibition of old furniture at the museum. It sounds boring but it wasn’t. I took some photos which’ll be perfect for my history project.
Great.
Then we went to the swimming pool. Some workers were repairing the lifts. Their machines were so loud we didn’t stay long, but it was still fun.
Oh.
We also had a walk in the forest. Mum told me not to make any noise and we might see some rabbits. I’ve always wanted to see them – and I did! It was amazing!
Fantastic!
We also visited a market that sells things that don’t cost much. Usually it’s crowded but not then. We saw a clown there. Sometimes they’re scary but he really made us laugh.
Ha!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
